messages:
Nina (CS): Flagging Aerolith renewal - ~90 days out. Procurement just messaged that their signer is delegated to a finance director and theyneed a PO routing path. Also saw two onboarding flags: Okta claim mismatch and potential delay on seat provisioning if we wait on signature.
Raj (AM): Got it. Any specific term or price asks so we can prep the amendment?
Nina (CS): Theyasked about a 12->9 month shorter term option and whether an early-commit incentive is possible. Procurement wants PO vs card.
Sam (Finance): PO fine but need vendor code + invoice entity. Net terms?
Raj (AM): Aerolith prefers PO + Net30. They could pay card if urgent but procurementprefers PO.
Elena (Legal): For delegated signer we need the delegation letter (name, title, authorization). If they give a signed PDF we can set the DocuSign recipient accordingly; otherwise we need exec signature.
Maya (Onboarding): On SSO, their Okta admin surfaced attribute map differences that'll take ~3 workdays to align. If signature delays kickoff we risk a 10-14 day slip on seat provisioning. Recommend scheduling enablement contingent on signed agreement.
Nina (CS): Proposed path: 1) Request delegation PDF + PO number + vendor code; 2) Prepare DocuSign envelope addressed to delegated signer; 3) Tentatively hold enablement week 2 weeks after signature; 4) Offer a 4% early-commit credit if signed within 21 days. Thoughts?
Sam (Finance): 4% early-credit ok pending pricebook update. Need an example PO format from customer. E.g.:
```
PO: AER-PO-2026-0311
Amount: $78,400
Entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
```
Raj (AM): I'll confirm amounts and whether they want the shorter term on initial renewal or a mid-term amendment. They also mentioned a possible seat add-on during the term.
Elena (Legal): I'll draft a short delegated-signer acknowledgement: "Customer will provide an officer-signed delegation letter authorizing the named signer; Redwood reserves right to verify with customer's procurement." Will share draft by EOD.
Nina (CS): Thanks. Action plan: Raj - ask Aerolith for delegation PDF, PO number, vendor code (2bd); Elena - share draft acknowledgement (EOD); Sam - queue pricebook change for 4% early-credit (3bd); Maya - block provisional enablement slots and SSO checklist (2bd).
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_a1b2c3). Recipient pending.
Raj (AM): Reached out to Aerolith procurement. They've replied with PO number AER-PO-2026-0311 and said delegated signer is Marcus Li, Finance Director. Delegation PDF incoming.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope env_a1b2c3 updated recipient: Marcus Li <marcus.li@aerolith.com>. Status: sent.
Raj (AM): Marcus signed the envelope, status completed.
esign-bot: DocuSign env_a1b2c3 completed. Signed copy: https://docusign.example/signed/env_a1b2c3.pdf
Sam (Finance): Got signed copy. Vendor code provided: AER-VC-101. We'll issue invoice under Net30.
Maya (Onboarding): With signed agreement locking enablement for May 10-12. Sending invites and the pre-kickoff SSO checklist now.
Nina (CS): Great work. Closing loop: Sam please confirm invoice send date, Raj update customer thread, Elena upload acknowledgement to contract file. I'll mark renewal as progressing and re-open if any issues pop up. :white_check_mark:
